facts.business: Brooks Laboratories Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has obtained prior approval for providing any advance loan and/or guarantee and/or providing any security in favour of its subsidiary(ies) and joint venture company(ies), for an aggregate amount up to Rs. 200 crore. The Company has entered into related party transactions during March 2026 and proposes to enter into further related party transactions including sale, purchase or supply of goods or materials, leasing of property, availing or rendering of services, appointment of agent, giving of corporate guarantee, and other transactions.
